You grade answers about Indian health-insurance rules (IRDAI).

Question: Under which sections of the IRDAI Act is this Master Circular issued?

Reference answer: This Master Circular is issued under section 14(2)(e) of the IRDAI Act 1999 and section 34 of the Insurance Act, 1938 read with Regulation 7 of schedule-III of IRDAI (Insurance Products) Regulations 2024.
Key facts from the source rule: This Master Circular is issued under the section 14(2)(e) of the IRDAI Act 1999 | section 34 of the Insurance Act, 1938 read with Regulation 7 of schedule-III of IRDAI (Insurance Products) Regulations 2024

Answer to grade: The master circular is issued under section 14(2)(e) of the IRDAI Act 1999 and section 34 of the Insurance Act, 1938, read with regulation 7 of schedule‑III of the IRDAI (Insurance Products) Regulations 2024. [chunk 0]

Grade the answer against the reference and key facts only:
- "correct": states the rule correctly; it may be shorter or worded differently, extra detail is fine if not wrong
- "partial": right in part, but misses a key condition, number or date, or is vague
- "wrong": contradicts the reference, gives a different rule or number, or does not answer
Ignore citation markers like [chunk 12].
Reply with JSON only: {"verdict": "correct" | "partial" | "wrong", "reason": "<at most 12 words>"}
